paragraphs: Rabbi Binyamin bar Yefet, Yochanan’s student, less exact in his sayings than Chiyya bar Abba, Berakhot 38b; see there. On Zeira’s ascent, found him reporting Yochanan, Shabbat 53a. “Yose”—perhaps Assi—“asked Yochanan in Sidon”; some say Shimon ben Yaakov of Tyre; “I heard,” Berakhot 33a. In Ila’s name, Chullin 52b; Elazar’s, Yoma 29a; Sanhedrin 7a; Shevuot 18b; Megillah 16b, many expositions. He and Rabbi Ba had a case before Rabbi Yitzchak, Jerusalem Sanhedrin 1. In Yonatan’s name. Binyamin from Elazar, Ta'anit 29b: perhaps bar Yefet, often reporting him. Buried in Kefar Meron; see Shimon bar Yochai.
